name: Interior Window NC - QT4 Premium, Spray, Factory Primed Wood
_demonstration_note: Same module list as the bare-wood spray scenario, but substrate_state=SS_PRIMED_FACTORY in the ctx. The MOD_PREP_WINDOW module has wood sand/fill tasks gated to SS_BARE only and a separate scuff task gated to SS_PRIMED_FACTORY — only scuff fires here. The MOD_WINDOW_PRIME module's tasks both gate by SS_BARE so the entire prime module runs to zero hours. State branching working the same way it does for trim and doors.
